title: 第10章 庆祝相邀
content_zh:
夜色之中，大乌鸦应声之后又要飞走。

    韩榆忽然想起自己修为低下、宗门规矩颇多，又开口叮嘱：“寻找野生灵草灵果就好，不要去别人的田地、宗门的药园放肆惹祸。”

    “还有，往后夜里过来，轻易不要出现在人前。”

    大乌鸦如今认他为主，与他心意初步相通，理解这些话倒也并非难事，暗金瞳仁映着少年清瘦的面容，歪头“嘎“了一声，张开翅膀飞走。

    目送这大黑老鸹消失在黑暗中，韩榆心头微微振奋。

    方执事说韩榆这等四灵根修炼十年才有可能练气四层进入外门，如今他才修炼一个多月，已经练气一层，想来并不会用这么长时间抵达练气四层。

    还有，随着修为增加，身体各处血肉也随之增加，修炼炼血诀、凝出精血也更加轻松了。

    不过，按照李老道的说法，如今韩榆练气一层，算是踏上了“修仙正途”，也是时候修炼法术了。

    《青禾练气心法》带有两个法术：一个是御风术，脚下御风可奔走，手上御风放出可击打面前敌人——之前李老道被王管事一下击飞吐血，便是这最基础的御风术。

    以韩榆的亲眼所见，这御风术击打敌人的威力真是极小，用作奔走、逃跑大约可能效果更好。

    另一个则是控水术，练成之后，可以把小股水流挪移到自己想要的位置。

    韩榆仔细一想，看向水缸、水桶。

    这两个法术，用来给灵田提水、浇水，倒是绝佳。

    用了御风术，提水跑得快，用了控水术，直接浇水入灵田，不用一点一点慢慢浇。

    刚突破到练气一层，韩榆虽然跃跃欲试，但因为《青禾练气心法》上说明，需要巩固几日周天之后，才可习练法术，也只好忍耐下来。

    接下来两日，韩榆都没有出门，每日一个灵米饭团将自己刚刚突破练气一层的灵息平稳过渡，周天越发稳固之后，他尝试修炼御风术与控水术。

    正如他之前预料那样，御风术初学乍练，掐手诀运灵息，叱喝一声“去”之后，仅仅是在屋内卷起一阵风而已，用在腿上，倒是真的省力轻快。

    控水术刚一开始练，也不过是把一桶水挪移一丈远，也同样并不算多么实用。

    说到底，法术的威力受限于是否精通熟练，更受限于修行者本身修为实力，韩榆要想让这两个法术发挥更大作用，还得多加练习，提升修为。

    这倒是让韩榆不由地跟《炼血诀》这个假仙之法对比了一下，《炼血诀》并非修仙正途，并无延年益寿、身心通泰的妙用，但血滴子、养灵术这两个法术，那是真实用，初学乍练就有威力。

    虽然修行弊端多，实用性却高，韩榆倒是没必要彻底放弃。
content_en:
In the night, the big crow answered the call and then flew away.

Han Yu suddenly remembered that his cultivation was low and the sect had many rules, and he warned again: "Just look for wild spiritual grass and spiritual fruits. Don't go to other people's fields or the sect's medicine garden and cause trouble."

"Also, come here at night and don't show up in front of others."

The big crow now recognized him as his master and initially connected with his thoughts. It was not difficult to understand these words. The dark gold eyes reflected the young man's thin face, he tilted his head and let out a "croak", then spread his wings and flew away.

Watching the big black bird disappear into the darkness, Han Yu felt slightly excited.

Deacon Fang said that it would take Han Yu and others ten years of practicing the four spiritual roots to be able to enter the outer gate at the fourth level of Qi training. Now he has only been practicing for more than a month and has already reached the first level of Qi training. It would not take such a long time to reach the fourth level of Qi training.

Also, as one's cultivation level increases, the flesh and blood in various parts of the body also increases, making it easier to practice the Blood Refining Technique and condense blood essence.

However, according to Li Laodao, Han Yu is now at the first level of Qi training and has embarked on the "correct path of cultivating immortality". It is also time to practice magic.

"Qing He Lian Qi Xin Technique" has two spells: one is the wind control technique. You can use the wind under your feet to run, and you can use the wind control on your hands to hit the enemies in front of you. Previously, Li Laodao was knocked away by Manager Wang and vomited blood. This is the most basic wind control technique.

From what Han Yu had seen with his own eyes, the power of this wind control technique to hit the enemy was really very small. It might be more effective if it was used for running and escaping.

The other is water control. After mastering it, you can move a small stream of water to the location you want.

Han Yu thought carefully and looked at the water tank and bucket.

These two spells are excellent for lifting and watering spiritual fields.

I used the wind control technique to carry water and run faster, and I used the water control technique to water water directly into the spiritual field, instead of pouring it slowly bit by bit.

Having just broken through to the first level of Qi training, Han Yu was eager to give it a try, but because the "Qinghe Qi Training Method" stated that it needed to be consolidated for several days and weeks before he could practice spells, he had to endure it.

For the next two days, Han Yu didn't go out. Every day, he took a rice ball to smoothly transition his spiritual energy that had just broken through the first level of Qi training. After Zhou Tian became more and more stable, he tried to practice wind control and water control.

Just as he expected before, he was just learning the art of wind control. He pinched his hands to move the spirit breath. After shouting "Go", he just blew up a gust of wind in the room. When used on his legs, it was really effortless and light.

When I first started practicing the water control technique, I just moved a bucket of water ten feet away, which was also not very practical.

After all, the power of a spell is limited by proficiency and proficiency, and even more by the practitioner's own cultivation strength. If Han Yu wants to make these two spells more effective, he still needs to practice more and improve his cultivation.

This made Han Yu couldn't help but compare it with the "Blood Refining Technique", a fake immortal method. "Blood Refining Technique" is not the right way to cultivate immortality, and it has no magical effect of prolonging life and improving physical and mental health. However, the two spells of Blood Drops and Soul Nourishing Technique are real and powerful, and they are powerful as soon as they are practiced by beginners.

Although there are many drawbacks to practice, it is highly practical, so there is no need for Han Yu to give up completely.
